briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI accelerate frontier model releases as AGI race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI landscape shows rapid advancement in reasoning models from multiple labs with heightened geopolitical focus on compute access. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount around deployment risks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with enhanced multi-step reasoning. xAI launched Grok-3 claiming superior coding benchmarks. Google DeepMind and Anthropic continue internal testing of next iterations.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments ramping to 500k units quarterly. Microsoft and Google expanded data center capacity in Texas and Arizona with new nuclear-linked power deals.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory frameworks in the US and EU slow frontier model progress enough to allow China to close the capability gap by 2028?
